page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-32 is a virtual machine instance belonging to the c4d server family. It is configured with 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 CPU architecture. The instance features 124.0 GB of system memory, which provides a resource density of 3.88 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance type does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware accelerators. It also does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Network and storage operations rely entirely on attached cloud storage volumes and standard virtual network interfaces.

From a resource density perspective, the c4d-standard-32 offers a balanced allocation of compute and memory resources, aligning with general-purpose and moderately compute-heavy workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention. This profile is suitable for workloads such as web serving, application servers, containerized microservices, and medium-scale database hosting where local storage and GPU acceleration are not required.
